name: add_party_character

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_AddPartyCharacter passes the top character ID to Party_AddCharacter and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: Party_AddCharacter leaves an already-present ID unchanged; otherwise it writes IDs below 10 into the first empty byte among the four party-roster slots at game-state offsets 0x48E through 0x491. The three JP calls add character IDs 5 or 9 during event cleanup.
